title: English Practice Quiz 0159
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Which word rhymes with 'light'?
questions.explanation: Light and night share the same ending sound.

questions.question: He said, 'I am tired.' Reported speech:
options: He said that he was tired.
questions.explanation: In standard backshift, am changes to was after a past reporting verb.

questions.question: I ___ him last week.
questions.explanation: Use the past simple with a finished past time such as last week.

questions.question: A colleague asks for help. A polite reply is:
questions.explanation: Certainly. What do you need? is helpful and polite.

questions.question: Choose the passive form: 'The manager signed the letter.'
options: The letter was signed by the manager.
questions.explanation: Past simple passive: was/were + past participle.

questions.question: I think it ___ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Will plus the base verb can express a future prediction.

questions.question: Someone says, 'Thank you for your help.' You reply:
questions.explanation: You're welcome is a natural response to thank you.

questions.question: If you heat ice, it ___.
questions.explanation: The zero conditional uses present simple for general truths.

questions.question: You ___ wear your identity card at work.
questions.explanation: Modal verbs such as should are followed by the base verb without to.

questions.question: Choose the correct question.
questions.explanation: Use do + subject + base verb for present simple questions with you.
